view_contract.compiler: fnasm --raw, fndiff --raw and probe --raw select the configured compile edge before Frank and later transforms. require_exists=False is reserved for build-target selection.
view_contract.freshness_limit: Path selection does not check all compiler/header/tool dependencies or file timestamps. Run Ninja for dependency freshness. Configured compiler rules may contain declared cleanup, so compiler-stage is not a claim of untouched executable output under every historical generator.
view_contract.pre_postprocessor: cn_analyze preserves rule-input semantics: select the active WebFrank/P6 input. With upstream Frank it is already transformed and labelled NOT compiler raw. Probe withholds its secondary cn-derived word count if the two views name different objects.
view_contract.refusal: Missing/stale/unsupported/ambiguous graph, cycle, foreign compiler ancestry, missing active readable output, escaping path, incomplete generator hashes and legacy in-place exception overwrite refuse. They do not fall back to an existing processed or retired object.

subject: tool:raw-object
value: At f9ca80762, fnasm.raw_obj_path, fndiff raw selection, probe.raw_object_target and cn_analyze.our_object all preferred an existing retired sndvoice .postprocess/body artifact. That object had 42 differing words in sndVoiceUpdateAll despite the active plain compiler object being raw exact at 822/822 instructions. The shared resolver now follows the hash-bound active build chain: all four select the plain object and report zero differing words with the phantom still present. This repairs artifact selection, not compiler behavior, source matching, dependency freshness or the remaining independent tool selectors.
